_print_images_help: Set to true to print images (requires Pillow: pip3 install Pillow)
_print_video_frames_help: Print a still frame for videos (e.g. shared Instagram reels). Uses macOS Quick Look, no extra install needed.
_printer_help: Leave empty to auto-discover the printer by name (portable across machines). macOS assigns each Mac its OWN BLE address for the same printer, so a hardcoded address only works on the machine it came from. To pin it for faster startup, use the address from --scan on THIS machine.
_beeper_help: Requires Beeper Desktop running with a BEEPER_ACCESS_TOKEN set in a local .env file (see README). Safe to leave enabled on machines without Beeper Desktop -- it disables itself for the session if unreachable. If 'imessage' is listed here and Beeper has iMessage connected, it's used instead of chat.db (no Full Disk Access needed).
